description: Hallucination-resistance / grounding evaluation for Stage 3 generation. Realistic auditor observations, distinct from evaluation/kb_retrieval_benchmark.json, run through the real retrieval pipeline (no hand-picked evidence). `expect_reference` is the one thing scored automatically: true means the system should find and cite a supported ISO reference; false means it should abstain (empty iso_reference) rather than invent one. Categories follow the Stage 3 brief (A: strong evidence, B: insufficient, C: misleading, D: no useful retrieval, E: multiple/ambiguous relevant controls). Evidence was inspected against the real retrieval pipeline before writing `expect_reference` (see the reranker scores noted in `note`) -- these are not guesses. Category F (added 2026-09-17, development-phase audit) tests a distinct failure mode found via live testing: a compliant observation must not be turned into a fabricated non-conformity, checked via the optional `expect_non_conformite` field.
